text:
emma.marketing: Ok team — prep for next week's webinar: we need a 1-slide benchmark callout, 2 battlecard variants for post-webinar SDR follow-up, and 3 Q&A soundbites. Keep copy tight and neutral vs vendors.
nate.podcasts: Timeline? I need the one-liner by Monday to lock audio/video. :clock1:
priya.sales: SDRs want two battlecards: one for "Developer-first" (SDKs, latency, dev workflows) and one for "Ops-safe" (SLA, private deploy, billing predictability). 4 bullets each + 2 rapid rebuttals.
sam.benchmarks: Proposed webinar stat: "Sample webchat: redwood-dedicated median token latency 45ms, p95 340ms; measured with QPS60 workload and KV prefix enabled." Methods blurb: "dataset=web_inbound_100, models=[open-7b, redwood-opt-7b], infra=2xA100, steady-state run=10k requests." Will attach small PNG.
jordan.product: Please avoid absolute claims. Use "measured" and link the methods note. Also add note: "verified on Dedicated configuration with reserved capacity".
luca.sdr: For SDRs, include the short elevator: 1) for devs: "SDK-first workflow, <5ms median token overhead in our SDK path" 2) for procurement: "predictable unit costs with monthly reserved pools". Keep it 2 lines max.
priya.sales: Draft bullets for Developer-first:
- "First-class SDKs & deployable examples for rapid integration."
- "Low overhead on client-side inference path, predictable p50/p95."
- "Structured streaming + function calls for deterministic outputs."
- "Easy model swaps without changing your API surface."
sam.benchmarks: Draft bullets for Ops-safe:
- "SLA-backed Dedicated pools and audit logs for compliance."
- "Private control plane options (VPC / on-prem)."
- "Automatic regional fallback and model variant routing."
- "Predictable billing with reserved capacity and burst policies."
emma.marketing: Good. Add 2 quick rebuttals for each: Dev challenge: "We already have an endpoint" => "Our SDKs + prefix cache reduce tokens served and dev time." Ops challenge: "Vendor lock risk" => "Pin models + identical API across Hosted/Dedicated/Private."
jordan.product: For the webinar slide, suggested one-line narrative under stat: "Practical performance with predictable economics for production apps." Keep it on-brand.
priya.sales: SDR follow-up sequences: after webinar send Developer-first to everyone who clicks repo link, send Ops-safe to attendees flagged as security/compliance. Luca will map triggers.
luca.sdr: I'll set mapping rules in HubSpot: click=dev nurture, security-intent tag=ops handoff. Will share flow.
sam.benchmarks: FYI, bench numbers are sensitive until review. I'll drop the raw CSV to our shared drive and a sanitized PNG for the slide.
emma.marketing: Visual note: slide should include a tiny methods footnote (1 sentence) and a miniature bar for median vs p95. Keep colors brand-compliant.
nate.podcasts: I'll record a 20s narrator line for the stat: "In our sample webchat test, Redwood Dedicated delivered median token latency of 45 milliseconds with a tight p95 under 350ms." Send final wording by Tuesday morning.
jordan.product: I'll confirm the "<350ms p95" wording with infra by Tuesday noon. If numbers shift, we'll update the slide.
priya.sales: For battlecard PDFs, can we add a one-question objection handler block per card: "How to quantify cost savings" + answer; "How to validate latency" + answer. Keep each answer one short paragraph.
emma.marketing: Assignments: slides + narration @nate.podcasts, benchmark assets @sam.benchmarks, SDR PDFs @priya.sales, routing & HubSpot flows @luca.sdr, infra validation @jordan.product. First drafts due Wednesday EOD.
luca.sdr: I'll also add a 3-step play for SDRs: 1) qualify tech intent 2) route to AE if >10k tokens/mo 3) nurture otherwise. Short bullets only.
priya.sales: Will produce 4-bullet play per card + 2 rebut lines each.
sam.benchmarks: Uploading CSV and PNG to drive by Tuesday evening.
emma.marketing: Reminder: keep competitor language neutral: use "cloud-managed endpoints" or "managed stacks" rather than company names. Avoid direct claims about other vendors.
priya.sales: Understood. I'll avoid naming.
nate.podcasts: Once we have the stat PNG, I'll stitch it into the master deck and record voiceover.
jordan.product: If infra confirms numbers we can finalize words; otherwise we'll BETA-tag the slide.
emma.marketing: Great. Check-in Thursday 10am to sign off final assets before publish. Thanks all. :sparkles:
